notes: Sheet has a MAIN panel and an INSET. The heavy double border runs from a corner at ~(1883,2867) NE to ~(3850,1080) and SE to ~(3200,4600); everything right/below it is the INSET = block 5 (Huntington Pl / Auburn Av / Estelle / Auburn Terrace), whose top runs off the main panel's top edge, redrawn displaced by about (+770, +2356) px with the same orientation and scale (checked: main Estelle/Auburn Terrace (2061,1420) vs inset (2838,3782); main Malvern SE corner (1900,1310) vs inset (2670,3667)). Inset picks carry part=inset and need their own georeference; in the main panel block 5 is blank and labelled '172'. Inset prints 'HUNGTONON PL.' (sic, with small 'HUNTINGTON PL.' on the lots) and 'ESTELLA' (small 'ESTELLE' beside it); main panel prints 'ESTELLE' -> all recorded as Huntington Place / Estelle Street. Inset Estelle/Auburn Av point is at the very right edge of the scan. Inset also shows the 'MALVERN PL.' label at the Malvern opening on the SW side of Auburn Terrace (not picked again). Auburn Terrace is printed 'AUBURN TERRACE (SYCAMORE)', 25 ft, one straight line from the top edge (NW leg stub) across Huntington, past Malvern (T from SW) and Estelle (T from NE, offset ~145 px SE of Malvern), across Dorchester (cross; SE leg 25 ft drawn as 163 outline, addresses 2000/2001). Main Street: 50 ft north of Dorchester; widened on the NE side to 85 ft between Dorchester and the Sycamore/Excelsior junction; then continues SE 50 ft (163 outline, unlabelled) narrowing to ~25 ft near Dorsey ('MAIN' printed on the lot edge at ~(2655,4195)); all Main points use the 50 ft alignment centreline x = 1291 + 0.917*(y-2693). Main/Dorchester (1410,2812) is on Dorchester's centreline close to that alignment (the 85 ft centreline would give ~(1485,2740)). Main/Huntington Place falls off the left edge (binding) on this sheet (it is on 171). At the bottom right Main meets Dorsey and continues south as Lang (printed 'LANG', ~51 ft, unlabelled width): recorded as Main/Dorsey and Lang/Dorsey at the same point; Dorsey bends NE there ('DORSEY' printed on the NE leg). Sycamore ('SYCAMORE 6" W.P.', width not printed, only the west line and pipe drawn) leaves the Auburn Av/Dorchester junction SSW and its SW end (50 ft, outline) meets Main at (1985,3450); the middle of it lies under the inset. Excelsior's east end turns NE into an open passage meeting Main at (1890,3346), offset one street width NW of Sycamore (key map shows Excelsior and Sycamore as one line). Auburn Av/Dorchester: Dorchester's SW leg (40 ft here) meets Auburn at (3548,862); an unlabelled ~50 ft leg leaves the NE side at (3609,928), offset ~90 px SE (taken to be Dorchester continuing, per key map); Sycamore Ts in at (3628,948); Auburn Av continues SE past the junction. Dorchester printed 50 ft west of Auburn Terrace and 40 ft east of it. Bodman Avenue (printed only 'BODMAN' here, a stub; key map and sheet 174 'BODMAN', sheet 173 'BODMANN AV.'; SE line only, NW line is off the top edge) Ts into Auburn Av; its point assumes a 40-50 ft width (+/- 20 px). McIlvaine (printed 'McILVAINE', ~42 ft, 163 outline) leaves Dorchester's SE side to the SE. McGrew (not opened) x 342-529; Gage and Winkler are stubs from sheet 171 at the left edge. Norton Alley (printed 'NORTON ALLEY', 13 ft at McGrew, 15 ft elsewhere) runs diagonally from McGrew SE to Excelsior; Norris Alley (printed 'NORRIS ALLEY', ~11 ft) runs from McGrew east to Norton Alley. An unlabelled ~10 ft strip (x 1666-1700) runs from Excelsior south to the rear of the Dorsey lots; it may just be the gap between the block 4 lots and the 163 outline. Scale: 50 ft = ~170 px.
